title: Insurance Verification Intake Form
subtitle: Capture coverage source, member reference, service date, and network status; confirm benefit response and patient notice.
description: Insurance Verification records coverage source, member reference, service date, network status, benefit response, and patient notice. Insurance Verification evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this insurance verification structured intake when staff must document coverage source and member reference. Reconcile service date, network status, benefit response, and patient notice before the insurance verification handoff. Use the payer response, portal screenshot or call reference, representative name, benefit summary, network response, authorization indicator, patient estimate route, and notice receipt. This administrative record centers payer eligibility, plan dates, network response, benefit limitation, deductible or cost-share source, authorization indicator, representative reference, and patient notice. Ask the assigned insurance verification reviewer to confirm coverage source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Insurance Verification contact and reference
sections.guidance: Record payer and plan source, member reference, service date, network response, benefit limitation, authorization indicator, call reference, and patient notice.

sections.title: Insurance Verification reported needs
sections.guidance: Preserve the person's wording and route questions without interpretation.

blocks.label: Insurance Verification stated need or goal

fields.label: Person's words, desired outcome, and priority

blocks.label: Insurance Verification intake readiness
items: Coverage source is identified for this record
Member reference matches the current request or source
Service date is ready for point-of-use staff
Network status limits or questions are resolved
Benefit response is communicated to the responsible person
Patient notice is confirmed at handoff

sections.title: Insurance Verification exception review and receiving route
sections.guidance: Assign open questions and confirm where the intake goes next.

blocks.label: Insurance Verification intake receipt
blocks.guidance: Receipt confirms routing, not professional review.
